about_the_game:
Buff your heroes and your battles with the MGC Animations Collection Vol 3! ManuGamingCreations is back with another set of Effekseer animations for MZ to add some extra flair to your skills. Power up your paladins with glowing swords, make it easy for your players to tell what element resistance is being put on their party members with different casting animations, burn enemies with roaring flames, and more with this pack!

76 animations are split into 9 different sections to make it easy to find what you want. 8 casting types, 13 flames, 5 holy sword moves, 7 cero blasts, and 13 runes and spells offer up a bunch of options to power up your mages’ skill sets and add some interesting buff/debuff animations to all your party members. And if that wasn’t enough, there are also more random animations in the variety and RPG sections: 14 in variety #1 that include sci-fi blasts and explosions in various colors, 5 in variety #2 that include dark X-shaped attacks, 8 in RPG #1 with purple moves that drain the target before exploding, and 3 in RPG #2 that include a fire attack that pours lava over its target!

This pack also includes an MZ project so you can see how each animation can work with the default sounds, or copy-paste them into your game to quickly add new moves to your battles. If you’ve been wanting to upgrade your different spells or need to annihilate enemies with overwhelming explosions, check out the MGC Animations Collection Vol 3!


Contents:

71 Various animations:

-8x Elemental Cast Animations
-13x Flames Animations
-5x Holy Sword Animations
-7x Cero Energy Animations
-6x Runes Animations
-6x Runes Spells Animations
-5x SciFi Projectile Animations
-5x SciFi Impact Animations
-11x RPG Fire & Dark Spells Animations
-1x Dark Shockwave Animation
-1x Red Vertical Beam Animation
-3x X-Attack Animation

Includes sample project!


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
